fields.summary_ko.0: TSM rose 33.2% over the past year, significantly outpacing semiconductor sector's 6.8%, showing external growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 2026 revenue of $46.72B represents 41.2% YoY increase, net profit surged 68.7%, with HPC revenue increasing to 68% of total.
fields.summary_ko.2: Advanced technology 7nm and below represents 79% of Q3 wafer revenue, 2nm technology accounts for 8%, with plans to more than double N2 annual production capacity in 2027.
